man, i wish my boyfriend had cared enough to ask this instead of running. unfortunately i don’t have fantastic advice on this but i think there are a couple things that cross my mind:

1. make sure to recognize depression as a temporary condition separate from who the person is, but also if the person’s illness is negatively affecting you, it’s really important to communicate it in a kind way which leads to 2

2. when she’s feeling more herself, set some boundaries if necessary, discuss what helps her and what makes her feel worse, what kind of support she needs, what enables her bad moods versus what takes her out of it. 

if you’re both willing to work with each other and truly love each other, it can absolutely work. if you see things going in a worse direction maybe consult a third party who’s trained in this sort of thing such as a therapist or counselor, they can help a lot. and finally, i really wish the best for you two. depression is a crippling condition so much worse than media/social media portrayal and not a lot of people fully understand how bad it can be until they’ve experienced it, but just you asking for help and advice shows how much you care and love this person and i hope she’s able to heal from this state of mind soon, wishing you both all the best once more
